places.quote: going over to Blunderstone, and revisiting the old familiar scenes of my childhood
places.note: Dickens's fictional name for the real village of Blundeston, near Lowestoft; the passage is set there during the walks.

places.quote: My nearest way to Yarmouth, in coming back from these long walks, was by a ferry.

places.normalized: The Willing Mind (fictional inn, Yarmouth area)
places.quote: Peggotty’s house of call, ‘The Willing Mind’
places.note: Invented house of call; location not given beyond the Yarmouth area.

places.quote: Our old neighbours, Mr. and Mrs. Grayper, were gone to South America
I told you at the inn in London, I am heavy company for myself
